command: set -euo pipefail; adb logcat -c; adb shell input tap 503 159; sleep 5; test -n "$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r')"; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-running.xml >/dev/null; echo '--- RUNNING_UI ---'; adb shell cat /sdcard/tracker-running.xml | grep -oE 'text="[^"]*"|content-desc="[^"]*"' | head -n 80; echo '--- RUNNING_LOG_ERRORS ---'; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); adb logcat -d -v brief --pid="$PID" | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|SecurityException|IllegalStateException|SQLiteException|OutOfMemoryError' || true
